scope: Substantial new public human-facing pages; retrospective migration prioritized by traffic, importance, and dryness.
rule: Every substantial new human-facing surface SHOULD include at least one meaningful hero visual, rich-media demonstration, interactive illustration, or accessible equivalent; exceptions require an explicit reason.

creative_modes.CoDry: Minimal legible text-first reference and low-bandwidth fallback
creative_modes.CoWet: Visual storytelling that communicates the underlying evidence
creative_modes.CoJaz: Rhythmic motion, playful contrast and improvisational exploration
creative_modes.CoGayAsAPeachBaby: Opt-in exuberant, colorful, joyful experimental presentation

media.hero: Must express the core concept, not generic decoration.
media.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; avoid flashing and seizure risks.
media.audio: Start silent. Scrolling alone must never unmute, raise volume, or begin audible playback. Require an affirmative audio activation.
media.audio_control: Visible mute/unmute with persistent user preference where authorized; honor system-level reduced-sensory settings when available.
media.CoAudioFkOff: Global opt-out contract for participating surfaces, no surprise sound, no nagging to re-enable; if preference cannot be shared across domains, disclose that limitation.
media.captions: Provide transcript/captions and visual equivalent for meaningful audio.
media.autoplay: Silent visual animation only where permitted; stop on reduced motion or page hidden.

quality_gates: Source-linked claims and accessible alt text
Evidence and receipt links remain visible
retrofit_priority: Expected comprehension and user benefit divided by migration cost; prioritize public onboarding and product surfaces over internal logs.
tests: Without audio consent, scrolling 100% of the page produces zero audible sound.
CoAudioFkOff prevents sound across all participating surfaces that receive the preference.
With reduced motion, hero remains comprehensible without animation.
With media disabled, title, purpose, evidence and action remain accessible.
Hero communicates one tested concept rather than a misleading decorative claim.
Keyboard-only visitor can access all controls and turn sound off immediately.
next: Build a static accessible CoWet hero demo and audit existing human-facing pages; do not claim policy is enforced until CI and runtime evidence exist.
relations: CoSeed: every visual claim points to source evidence
CoPath: visual explorations expose reversible routes to detail and receipts
CoHog: visual challenge surface invites independent critiques
CoOmni: multiple fronts can derive presentations from the same typed evidence
